verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover the whole flow: a get-started guide promising to "run code on a remote GPU in minutes", Pod creation from the console or CLI (`runpodctl pod create`), and programmatic creation through the REST and GraphQL APIs. Templates are described as ready instantly, and access is via SSH, JupyterLab or VS Code. Community users say H100s are easy to get and templates take a few clicks, but one report describes 4090 'low availability' and instances not booting correctly. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of time-to-running-code, consistent GPU availability (a community report contradicts it for some GPU types).
